events.title: Halloween is here, just in time for Steam Next Fest!

events.title: Good news: Grimoire of Blanks is coming sooner!
events.summary: Grimoire of Blanks will now release on November 6!Development is coming along nicely, and I’m excited to get the game into your hands sooner. Releasing on Friday also means I’ll be available over the weekend if any important fixes are needed.I can’t wait to share it with you!

events.title: Endless Mode!
events.summary: Hey everyone!Today I finished Endless Mode for the full release!Endless Mode is available solo or in co-op. Run through different biomes with ever-increasing difficulty and see how far you can survive.There are two ways to play. You can start a new Endless run using your unlocked biomes, or you can finish a normal run and continue into Endless Mode with your current build.Just perfected your build before the normal run ends? Keep going and find out how far it can carry you!Biome routes are short

events.title: Card design and Spelleffect Update
events.summary: Today I pushed the latest update that now includes a unique particle animation for each effect word! Gone are the boring family based effects! Try them out now! I also updated the card designs a little and gave each family their own color variants. (19 in total)

events.title: Demo Update: A New Path Opens!
events.summary: After defeating the Goblin Matriarch, you can now unlock The Unsealed Aquifer—a completely new Act 1 biome filled with dangerous currents, strange sewer creatures, new elites, and the fearsome Palimpsest Leviathan.The demo now also includes difficulty settings. Defeat the Matriarch to unlock the first additional difficulty and put your spellcrafting skills to the test.Will you return to the Stolen Camp, or descend into the flooded depths?

events.title: The Store Page & Demo Are Live!
events.summary: I’m excited to announce that the Steam store page and playable demo for Grimoire of Blanks are now live!The game also received its first 70 wishlists in the first week. As a solo developer, seeing people discover and take an interest in my game means a lot to me. Every wishlist, demo download, and bit of feedback helps support the project.A huge thank-you to everyone who has already visited the store page, played the demo, shared the game, or added it to their wishlist.
